role: An XP orb: spawned by deaths, smelting and the dev orb op, attracted to the nearest player within 8 blocks, collected on contact for its xpValue.

members.name: xpColor
members.note: the render colour counter; its tick increment is server state

members.name: xpOrbAge
members.note: the shared EntityItem.age slot, 6000-tick despawn

members.name: field_70532_c
members.note: the pickup delay slot shared with EntityItem.delayBeforeCanPickup

members.name: xpOrbHealth
members.note: the shared health slot, starts at 5

members.name: closestPlayer
members.note: collapsed to a boolean cache over the one server player the pool holds, plus the frozen position of an old EntityPlayerMP respawnPlayer replaced (xp_target_left, ie_player_left): setPlayerLocation moved it to the fresh player's placement, and the orb pulls there until a rescan finds it over 8 blocks away (respawn-loop-s1)

members.name: EntityXPOrb
members.note: size 0.5/0.5, the rotation and initial-motion draws from Det.mathRandom

members.name: EntityXPOrb
members.note: the bare World constructor is the replay's NBT-adopt path (size 0.25/0.25)

members.name: canTriggerWalking
members.note: the spawn path clears entity.can_trigger_walking

members.name: entityInit
members.note: empty body

members.name: getBrightnessForRender
members.note: client light value for rendering; not part of the server state

members.name: onUpdate
members.note: gravity 0.03, the lava bounce and fizz draw, pushOutOfBlocks, the entity-id-mod-100 target refresh, the 8-block attraction, friction, the 6000-tick despawn

members.name: handleWaterMovement
members.note: the orb's unexpanded-box override of the water push

members.name: dealFireDamage
members.note: folds into the shared attackEntityFrom body

members.name: attackEntityFrom
members.note: health down by the amount, dead at or below 0, always returns false

members.name: writeEntityToNBT
members.note: Health/Age/Value shorts, entity_nbt.c:261-263

members.name: onCollideWithPlayer
members.note: the player's tick sweep calls it: xpCooldown 2, the orb sound draws, addExperience, setDead (survival.c:1525-1536)

members.name: getXpValue
members.note: a getter over the field

members.name: getTextureByXP
members.note: RenderXPOrb's texture choice, client-only

members.name: getXPSplit
members.note: also drops.c:drops_xp_split for the block-break form

members.name: canAttackWithItem
members.note: n/a: EntityPlayer.attackTargetEntityWithCurrentItem is never handed an orb: NetHandlerPlayServer.processUseEntity refuses an attack on an EntityXPOrb, and the client cannot point at one (canBeCollidedWith is false)

missing: canAttackWithItem: a player's melee swing damaging an orb (EntityXPOrb returns false, so the orb survives) has no native counterpart; the item-entity pool has no attack-with-item entry point.
notes: Deaths spawn orbs through living.c:an_spawn_orb (EntityLivingBase's death XP), explosion.c:150 spawns the nether star's, survival.c:1373 the player-death split and survival.c:2527 the furnace's. dev.c:525 is the dev orb op. test_drops.c replays recorded item/orb entities including the xp value. lane/clientents: the live client's own EntityXPOrb copies (csrc/play/clientents.c citem_update: the pull toward the client player at its 0.12 eye height, xpColor from the copy's spawn) from its EntityTracker emulation, spawned where handleSpawnExperienceOrb puts them. idxaudit 2026-09-27: dropped evidence that runs none of this file's code (JaCoCo): cat-toss-s1.
